verdict.rationale: Jan's docs claim first-party integration with third-party coding agents ("Connect Jan with Claude Code, OpenClaw..."). Its local server exposes an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint that such agents can point at. Nothing in the evidence shows a single-command launcher that starts those CLIs pre-configured for local models; the integration may require manual endpoint configuration. Missing for 10: a documented single-command launch of agent CLIs, automatic pre-configuration with local models, a list of supported CLIs, and hands-on corroboration.
